products.name: IFB Executive Plus 10 kg front-load washing machine with Ai and Eco Inverter Motor
products.summary: Open the door to see the drum, pull out the detergent drawer and open the pump-filter door, then place it in your home at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap the door, the drawer or the round flap to open it
products.sizeNote: IFB gives 66.7 cm deep and does not say if that includes the door; here the door stands about 5 cm in front of it
specs: Eco Inverter Motor, 10 years motor warranty
5 star (BEE), 0.057 kWh/kg/cycle on its energy label
9 on the dial (Mix/Daily, Cotton, Synthetic, Baby Wear, Refresh, Express 15', Bulky, CradleWash, Spin Dry/Rinse) plus 12 in the My IFB app
Ai, Power Steam, Steam Refresh, 9 Swirl Wash, Warm Soak, Time Saver, Aqua Energie, Laundry Add
Wi-Fi and voice through the My IFB app
Touch keys and a dial, LED display
Black with chrome, hinged on the left, 320 mm opening
220-240 V, single phase, 50 Hz; 2000 W heater
4 years on the machine, 10 years on the motor, 10 years spare parts support

hotspots.title: Powered by Ai
hotspots.text: Ai detects the weight and type of the fabric, then tailors the water level, wash motions and time to suit the load.

hotspots.title: Power Steam
hotspots.text: Steam twice in the wash: at the start to dislodge dirt and kill 99.99% germs, and at the end to reduce wrinkles and keep clothes soft.

hotspots.title: 9 Swirl Wash
hotspots.text: Mimics hand wash motions to give your clothes the care they deserve.

hotspots.title: Eco Inverter Motor
hotspots.text: Consumes up to 40% less energy, and the washer operates quietly with minimal vibration.

fit.note: IFB's manual asks for at least 10 cm between the back and the wall. IFB publishes no gap for the sides, and no depth with the door open: leave room in front to open the door and to pull out the drawer.
